skill.name: specdd-risk
skill.description: Classifies risk before SpecDD work by checking write authority, spec chains, affected contracts, and verification needs.
skill.summary: Guides agents through SpecDD risk classification before planning, editing, or reviewing project work.
skill.author: specdd

content.value_statement: SpecDD work can fail when agents start without checking authority, contracts, or verification needs. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through a clear risk call before work begins.
actual_capabilities: Checks whether a project has the required SpecDD bootstrap file.
Defines the order for reading bootstrap files before work starts.
Guides agents to resolve the effective spec chain for a target.
Prompts review of contracts, security boundaries, data shape, and migrations.
Classifies requested work as low, medium, or high risk with reasons.
Ends with the smallest safe next step and required verification.
limitations: Only applies to projects that already use SpecDD bootstrap files.
Does not perform automated scanning or enforce policy by itself.
Requires accurate project specs to make reliable authority decisions.
Does not replace human approval for sensitive or destructive changes.

use_cases.title: Review Change Risk
use_cases.description: Classify a planned code change before an agent edits files or opens a pull request.

use_cases.title: Gate Sensitive Work
use_cases.description: Check security boundaries, migrations, secrets, releases, and tests before risky implementation work begins.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Agent Workflows
use_cases.description: Give Claude, Codex, or Claude Code a repeatable process for spec authority and risk decisions.

prompt_templates.title: Classify a Simple Task
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner risk check before a small change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use specdd-risk to classify this task before any edits: [describe task]. Identify authority, risk level, reasons, and next verification.

prompt_templates.title: Check Target Authority
prompt_templates.scenario: Confirm whether an agent may edit a target path.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use specdd-risk for [target path]. Resolve the governing spec chain and say whether write authority is clear before planning edits.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Sensitive Change
prompt_templates.scenario: Evaluate work touching public contracts or sensitive systems.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use specdd-risk for this proposed change: [change]. Focus on APIs, data, auth, secrets, migrations, dependencies, and tests.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Risk Across Options
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review when several implementation paths exist.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use specdd-risk to compare these options: [options]. Classify each risk level, cite governing specs, and recommend the smallest safe next step.

output_examples.input: Classify risk for a UI text update in a documented component.
output_examples.output: Risk: low. Authority is clear, no public contract changes are expected, and verification should include the relevant UI test or screenshot.

output_examples.input: Classify risk for a migration that changes account billing fields.
output_examples.output: Risk: high. The change affects persistent data, billing behavior, and rollback safety. Verify specs, migration tests, and approval before edits.

output_examples.input: Classify risk when the nearest spec does not grant write authority.
output_examples.output: Risk: medium. Authority is unclear, so stop before editing. Read the governing spec or request explicit operator approval.

best_practices: Run the risk check before planning, editing, reviewing, or testing a target.
Use exact bootstrap and governing spec text when authority or contracts matter.
State the smallest safe next step and concrete verification before continuing.
anti_patterns: Starting edits before confirming SpecDD write authority.
Treating nearby files or naming conventions as authority without spec support.
Ignoring migrations, secrets, releases, or external systems in the risk call.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it before risky SpecDD work or when a user asks for a risk classification.

faq.question: Does it edit project files?
faq.answer: No. The skill tells the agent not to edit files during risk assessment unless explicitly asked.

faq.question: What projects are supported?
faq.answer: It supports projects that already have a root .specdd/bootstrap.md file.

faq.question: What risk levels does it use?
faq.answer: It guides agents to classify work as low, medium, or high risk with concrete reasons.

faq.question: Can it replace security review?
faq.answer: No. It helps identify risk factors, but sensitive changes still need appropriate review and verification.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
